name: Fine Structure API
description:
Fine Structure is an AI software-building platform: it generates complete applications, runs autonomous AI agent teams, and maintains a business brain over your data.

Getting started is self-serve: sign up free at https://finestructure.ai (free tier included, no credit card), then create an API/MCP token at https://finestructure.ai/api-keys and pass it as `Authorization: Bearer fse2_mcp_<token>`.

Every operation below is also available as an MCP tool via the JSON-RPC endpoint POST /api/mcp (Streamable HTTP transport).
